en: Dependent on a non-root limited state, there arises a non-root, non-limited state by way of root condition... (In all cases, three.
Dependent on a root, sublime state, there arises a non-root, non-sublime state by way of root condition... Under root [condition], three... up to ... under non-disappearance [condition], three.

Dependent on a root, immeasurable state, there arises a non-root, non-immeasurable state by way of root condition... Under root [condition], three... up to ... under non-disappearance [condition], three.
